_comment: Deterministic payee rules, evaluated in order. First match wins. 'treatment' decides where a row lands: pl = profit & loss, equity/asset/liability = balance sheet only, transfer = excluded entirely, exception = never auto-decided, always routed to a human.

rules.note: Posts to Rental Income - Net because this is what the PM remitted. Wave also has Rental Income - Gross plus a Property Manager Clearing asset account and a Property Management Fees expense - that gross-up is the correct presentation and needs Certified Proper's annual statement. Gross reporting matters: the PM fee is a deduction you lose entirely if you only book net.
Title company wire - 400 Waterside St.

SALE PROCEEDS, NOT REVENUE. Form 4797. CRITICAL: Wave has NO Property, Plant & Equipment account and NO accumulated depreciation for 1109 - the building was never capitalised and no depreciation was ever recorded. Depreciation is 'allowed OR allowable': the IRS reduces basis by depreciation you should have taken even if you never took it. So the deduction was lost AND the recapture still applies. This needs the CPA before anything else on 1109.
Dreamhomes pass-through. Received AFTER the 1109 sale closed, then swept straight out. Almost certainly not 1109 income. Whose is it?

rules.note: All three Wave accounts already exist, plus the 1st Mortgage liability. Only the Form 1098 from Mr. Cooper is missing. Principal reduces the liability and is NOT an expense; only interest is deductible; escrow splits to property tax and insurance.
